name: From forecast to decision: release an activity call from three measured concentrations or measure the full series
question: Do the registered AnchorBoost forecasts let a laboratory decide more chemicals correctly from three measured concentrations than the measured concentrations alone, under the same calibrated release rule used for the patient report list?
forecasts: Registered k=3 AnchorBoost forecasts for the five published designs of every chemical, saved per fold on free Kaggle CPU by chip_forecast_decision.py --predict (sha256 df161e0d21b2...); their per-chemical curve errors equal chip_forecast_result.csv within 1.2e-7 for all 243 chemicals.

decision.endpoint: Full-series activity call of epa_release.py: active when the largest absolute DIV-mean response over 17 features and all tested concentrations is at least 3 (22.45% of fold-0 designs and 23.7% of folds 1-4 designs come from inactive chemicals).
decision.scores: anchorboost: largest absolute DIV-mean response over the full series, measured concentrations as measured and the others as forecast; measured_only: the same over the measured concentrations, which equals the log-linear interpolation score.
decision.rule: matched_regimen.py (sha256 f66e05c2...), the rule behind the patient report list: training rows fix the score cutoff for balanced accuracy and the reference ranks; calibration rows fix the release margin by conformal risk control, the smallest grid margin with (wrong releases + 1)/(n + 1) <= 0.10; a call is released when its rank margin exceeds that margin, otherwise the full series is measured.
decision.splits: test fold f; training folds = first two of the remaining folds in order, calibration folds = last two
decision.units: one row per (chemical, design); wells counted from the data; chemical bootstrap, 4,000 resamples, seed 0

development.note: Fold 0 is the development fold; splits, threshold 3 and alpha 0.10 were fixed before any AnchorBoost decision was computed (threshold from epa_release.py, alpha from the patient rule). After seeing fold 0, two reported layers were added: the full-coverage call error and coverage at equal realized risk.

pass_rules.R1_primary: full-coverage wrong calls per design, anchorboost minus measured_only: 95% upper bound below zero
pass_rules.R2_release_rule: anchorboost realized overall wrong-release share <= 0.10 and released share minus measured_only with 95% lower bound above zero

evaluation.reported_without_pass_rule: coverage at equal realized wrong-release share 0.05 and 0.10 with bootstrap gap intervals; wells used and saved; no comparison with the neural process, whose forecasts are not published
